key: Excuse me, I'm studying Pokémon Gang activity. Have you seen any suspicious behavior?
en: Excuse me, I'm studying Pokémon Gang activity. Have you seen any suspicious behavior?
ja: すみません、ポケモンギャングの活動を調査しているのですが。何か不審な行動を見ませんでしたか?

key: Well, that afforded an unpleasant diversion.
en: Well, that afforded an unpleasant diversion.
ja: ネヴィル: いや、それはなかなか不愉快な余興だったな。

key: Pokémon Gangs are not gangs of humans that use Pokémon, but rather the urban connection of Pokémon themselves...
en: Pokémon Gangs are not gangs of humans that use Pokémon, but rather the urban connection of Pokémon themselves...
ja: ポケモンギャングというのは、人間がポケモンを使うギャングのことではなく、ポケモン自身による都市部でのつながりのことでしてね…
実に興味深いものですよ!

key: Be careful if you plan to proceed.
en: Be careful if you plan to proceed.
ja: この先へ進むつもりなら気をつけてください。

key: I've seen more than a couple stray gentlemen stumble and hurt themselves on the jumps ahead.
en: I've seen more than a couple stray gentlemen stumble and hurt themselves on the jumps ahead.
ja: この先の飛び降りで足を滑らせて怪我をした、行き場のない紳士たちを何人も見てきましたので。
気をつけて跳んでくださいね?

key: Rusted and busted, this old place is the only good thing to come out of the quakes...
en: Rusted and busted, this old place is the only good thing to come out of the quakes...
ja: さびついてボロボロだが、この古い場所は地震の中で唯一まともに残ったもんだ…

key: Busted and dusted... Just like this old place.
en: Busted and dusted... Just like this old place.
ja: ブロディ: ボロボロでほこりだらけ…ちょうどこの古い場所みたいにな。

key: If this place never went under, where would we be now?!
en: If this place never went under, where would we be now?!
ja: ここが沈んでなけりゃ、俺たちは今頃どこにいたんだろうな?!
